schema: docs/SPEC.md section 5, "Say it your way" prompts
note: Only 'approved' prompts are served (dev builds may show drafts). Served in id order.

prompts.text: Describe your morning to someone who has never been to your city.
What's something you changed your mind about in the last year? What changed it?
Explain what you do all day to a curious ten-year-old.
Write about a small object you own that matters more than it should.
What's a piece of advice you ignored, and were you right to?
Describe a smell that takes you straight back somewhere.
What would you tell yourself on the first day of something you've since gotten good at?
Argue for your favorite season like you're trying to win.
What's something you do the hard way on purpose?
Write the first paragraph of a letter you'll never send.
